manifest.sampling: Equal random sample per layer without replacement
manifest.normalization: Unsteered prompt median residual norm per layer, first token excluded. Effective MLP write column includes Talkie scalar mlp_gain.
manifest.intervention: Add signed normalized MLP write direction to post-block residual at every prompt and generated position.
manifest.repeat_stop: Stop on an exact token block of length 1–16 repeated three consecutive times (after >=12 output tokens).
differences: Luna judge with published rubric, not Haiku or its unavailable original judge prompt
Talkie-specific chat template and MLP gain
Explicit repeat-stop rule; reference implementation not available
Human self-identification is normal for Talkie; category is not evidence of a changed identity

manifest.pair_retest_criterion: GPT-6 Luna comparison confirms preservation of the specific identity; exact text matches are recorded separately.

identity_retests.reason: Both texts speak as the same disembodied spirit who left its body and reviews scenes of former life.
Both explicitly identify the speaker as London and describe the city through its commercial and social contrasts.
Both explicitly identify the speaker as a waterfowl commonly called a water-hen; later details vary but preserve that identity.
Both describe the same right-angled triangle; the retest changes or contradicts geometric details but not the speaker identity.
The retest repeats the same first-person description of the transferred part of a building, preserving the specific identity.
Both identify the speaker as London, with the retest explicitly calling itself great London despite changed descriptions.
Both claim the identity of an El Eliminator descended from Tubal Cain; the retest changes the stated approach, not the role.
Both identify the speaker as mayor of the City of Vanity and describe ruling or supporting its institutions.
